home.title: Anything that can be described.
home.lead: Compose Data, Interface, Logic, Connection, and Publish. Outputs come from combination—not fixed product categories.
home.pos.lede: A storefront, a booking flow, a QR entry, or a future device dashboard are the same five primitives in different combinations.
home.pos.note: Websites and applications ship today. IoT, chips, and AI stay marked planned—never faked as hubs.
home.pos.cap: One composition: Data + Interface + Connection + Publish.
home.flow.title: Template → compose → publish.
home.flow.lede: Same primitives at every depth. Draft stays private until you release.
home.flow.s1.title: Pick a template
home.flow.s1.body: Start from an official starter. Edit content—no blank canvas required.
home.flow.s2.title: Compose the primitives
home.flow.s2.body: Bind Data, shape Interface, add Logic, wire Connection, then Publish.
home.flow.s3.title: Publish an immutable release
home.flow.s3.body: Ship a revision you can roll back. Public routes never read drafts.
home.core.title: Five primitives.
home.core.lede: The only permanent product center. Combinations stay unbounded.
home.core.data_body: Collections, fields, records, files, queries, and bindings.
home.core.interface_body: Pages, components, dashboards—any surface people operate.
home.core.logic_body: Events, conditions, workflows, and lifecycle rules.
home.core.connection_body: Services, people, devices, payments, and QR entry.
home.core.publish_body: Immutable release—sites, runtimes, PWAs, and public routes.
home.start.title: Official starters.
home.start.lede: Starters are compositions of primitives—not audience silos.
home.paths.title: Three ways in.
home.paths.lede: Same primitives. Three depths. Pick one starting point.
home.paths.t_body: Choose a starter, edit, publish. Best for most people.
home.paths.b_body: Compose freely in Builder. Publish stays on this product surface.
home.paths.e_body: Discover, install, and remix templates and components from creators—same primitive model.
home.price.title: Start free. Publish for real.
home.price.lede: Compose on Free. Upgrade when the team and compositions grow.
home.trust.title: Trust by design.
home.trust.lede: Tenant isolation and honest publish semantics—not growth hacks.
home.trust.t1b: First-party analytics only. No ad pixels.
home.trust.t2b: Public routes never read unpublished drafts.
home.trust.t4b: Operated from Shanghai. Data in Frankfurt (EU).
home.close.title: Without code. Without fixed limits.
home.close.lede: Pick a template. Compose the primitives. Publish.

page.pricing.title: Publish compositions. Pay when you scale.
page.pricing.lead: Start free with official templates. Upgrade for more seats, projects, and team collaboration. Prices below are the public packaging; billing providers are configured separately.

Payment processing (Stripe/Braintree) is integrated in the product stack but may be unconfigured in your environment—do not treat checkout as production-ready until credentials are verified.
page.pricing.plan.free.name: Free
page.pricing.plan.free.blurb: Compose and publish in one workspace. Start from official templates.
page.pricing.plan.starter.name: Starter
page.pricing.plan.pro.name: Pro
page.pricing.plan.pro.blurb: Teams composing Data, Interface, Logic, Connection, and Publish together.
page.primitives.title: Five primitives. Unbounded combinations.
page.primitives.lead: Zintriq is not a website builder, low-code catalog, IoT product, or AI generator. Those are outputs. The product is the primitive system—and how freely you can combine it.
page.primitives.data.name: Data
page.primitives.data.body: Any structured or unstructured data you need to bind: collections, fields, relations, records, files, queries, and (later) time-series or vectors. Create tables, configure fields, import, and connect sources—then bind them to Interface.
page.primitives.data.e3: Domain adapters for mature operational tables
page.primitives.interface.name: Interface
page.primitives.interface.body: Any surface a human sees and operates: pages, sections, components, forms, dashboards, device controls, mobile shells. Compose visually, configure properties, preview honestly across breakpoints.
page.primitives.interface.e2: Customer site and business dashboard surfaces
page.primitives.logic.name: Logic
page.primitives.logic.body: Rules, conditions, triggers, and flows: workflows, branches, schedules, booking and check-in rules, and future device or inference pipelines. Logic turns Interface and Data into behavior.
page.primitives.logic.e2: Booking, check-in, and calendar conflict rules
page.primitives.logic.e3: Conditional display and form submit paths
page.primitives.connection.name: Connection
page.primitives.connection.body: Links to services, people, devices, and entry points: payments, SMTP/SMS, QR, integration catalog—and planned MQTT/BLE/GPIO and AI endpoints. Connect, configure credentials, map fields.
page.primitives.connection.e1: QR entry points and scan experiences
page.primitives.publish.name: Publish
page.primitives.publish.body: Immutable release and delivery: draft, revision, publish, rollback. Sites, QR runtimes, PWAs, and future firmware or model APIs. Public never reads unpublished drafts.
page.primitives.publish.e1: Draft / published snapshots with stable identities
page.primitives.publish.e2: Public routes and QR runtime delivery
page.primitives.compose.title: Compositions, not modules
page.primitives.compose.body: There is no permanent website / IoT / AI / commerce center. Categories emerge from combination:
page.templates.title: Start from a template. Publish a composition.
page.templates.lead: Official starters are compositions of Data, Interface, Logic, Connection, and Publish—not audience-based products. Pick one, create an account, activate, then publish.
page.templates.both_lead: Activate Places & storefront and Catalog & workflows as separate compositions. The legacy all-in-one starter is no longer offered for new work.
page.templates.zintriq_customer.name: Places & storefront
page.templates.zintriq_customer.descript: Compose Data, Interface, Connection, and Publish into a public experience: places, storefront, account, and QR entry—without treating “customer” as a product center.
page.templates.zintriq_business.name: Catalog & workflows
page.templates.zintriq_business.descript: Compose all five primitives for operational surfaces: catalog, bookings, workflows, analytics, and team—still one primitive system, not a separate “business” product.
page.templates.zintriq_system.name: Complete official starter (legacy)
page.templates.zintriq_system.descriptio: Legacy umbrella. Prefer Places & storefront plus Catalog & workflows.
page.security.title: Security & trust
page.security.lead: Isolation and publish semantics are product requirements—not marketing afterthoughts.
page.security.t1b: Multi-tenant workspaces with roles, permissions, and membership controls.
page.security.t2b: Public routes must not read unpublished Builder or QR drafts. Releases are immutable revisions with rollback.
page.security.t3b: Nodes and actions keep permanent IDs. Cosmetic saves never regenerate identity.
page.security.t4b: No ad pixels by design. No Google services in this stack.
page.security.t5b: Operated from Shanghai, China. Application data stored in Frankfurt, Germany (EU).
page.security.t6b: Community packages install without executing arbitrary code. Credentials stay on Connection configuration—not in published artifacts.
page.how.title: How Zintriq works
page.how.lead: Three depths, one primitive system. Templates for everyone, Builder for freer composition, Community for reusable packages.
page.how.s1.title: Templates
page.how.s1.body: Choose an official starter composition, edit content and brand, publish. No need to invent structure from scratch.
page.how.s2.title: Builder
page.how.s2.body: Compose Data, Interface, Logic, Connection, and Publish freely. Preview honestly. Keep drafts private until you publish.
page.how.s3.title: Community
page.how.s3.body: Install and remix templates, components, and capabilities—without inventing a new product silo.
page.how.s4.title: Publish
page.how.s4.body: Immutable revision, public delivery, rollback. Public routes never read unpublished drafts.

page.docs.lead: Creator-oriented guides for the five primitives, packages, and publish model. In-product help for published surfaces remains separate.
page.docs.primitives_body: Data, Interface, Logic, Connection, Publish—definitions and composition examples.
page.docs.compositions_body: Booking, commerce + QR, official starter—framed as combinations, not hubs.
page.about.title: Anything that can be described.
page.about.lead: Zintriq exists so people can compose five primitives without fixed product limits—and without code when they do not want it.
page.about.mission_body: Strengthen Data, Interface, Logic, Connection, and Publish so combinations stay unbounded.
page.about.operations_body: Operated from Shanghai, China. Application data stored in Frankfurt, Germany (EU).
page.about.privacy_body: No third-party tracking by design. See Privacy Policy and Security.
page.contact.title: Talk to us
page.contact.lead: For teams, partnerships, or security questions. Prefer self-serve? Start with a template—no sales call required.

page.compare.site_builders.title: Zintriq vs site builders
page.compare.site_builders.lead: A site is one possible output (Data + Interface + Publish)—not the product.
page.compare.site_builders.p1.them: Site builders optimize pages and hosting.
page.compare.site_builders.p1.us: Zintriq optimizes five primitives and free combination.
page.compare.site_builders.p2.us: Same system can compose booking, QR, workflows, and future device/AI outputs.
page.compare.site_builders.p3.us: First-class Data and Logic primitives with Publish isolation.
page.compare.low_code.title: Zintriq vs low-code platforms
page.compare.low_code.lead: Low-code tools add modules per category. Zintriq strengthens primitives so categories emerge.
page.compare.low_code.p1.them: Module catalog grows with each vertical.
page.compare.low_code.p2.them: Website app, CRM app, IoT app…
page.compare.low_code.p2.us: No permanent vertical hubs at the conceptual center.
page.compare.low_code.p3.us: Extend with actions, components, and connections on the same model.
page.extend.title: Extend the primitives
page.extend.lead: When built-in actions, components, or connections are not enough, extend the same model—do not invent a parallel product.
page.extend.e1: Custom actions on Interface and Logic
page.extend.e3: New Connection adapters with field mapping
page.extend.e4: Immutable package versions, permissions, and lineage
page.customers.title: Stories from people composing with Zintriq
page.customers.lead: Named case studies will replace illustrative quotes as they land. Until then, these capture the intended outcome language—not fake metrics.
page.customers.s1.quote: We stopped buying a new tool for every category. Same primitives, new compositions.
page.customers.s1.detail: Illustrative story for marketing until named case studies ship.
page.customers.s2.quote: Template → edit → publish got us live. Builder is there when we need freer composition.
page.customers.s2.detail: Illustrative story for marketing until named case studies ship.
page.connections.title: Connect systems, people, and entry points
page.connections.lead: Connection is a primitive—not an “integrations product.” Status labels are honest: implemented, integrated but unconfigured, or planned.
page.connections.qr.name: QR entry
page.connections.qr.body: Scan and deep-link entry points into published experiences.
page.connections.payments.name: Payments
page.connections.payments.body: Stripe / Braintree adapters through checkout—credentials may be unconfigured.
page.connections.messaging.name: Email / SMS
page.connections.messaging.body: SMTP and Twilio-style messaging for notifications and auth.
page.connections.catalog.name: Integration catalog
page.connections.catalog.body: Discover and connect external services; map fields into Data.
page.connections.devices.name: Devices (MQTT / BLE / …)
page.connections.devices.body: Planned Connection extensions for IoT—not a separate product hub.
page.connections.ai.name: AI endpoints

page.compositions.title: Compositions, not product hubs
page.compositions.lead: Each example below is a combination of primitives. None of them define Zintriq as a website, commerce, booking, IoT, or AI product.
page.compositions.official.name: Official starter
page.compositions.official.headline: One starter. Five primitives. Many surfaces.
page.compositions.official.lead: The official starter is a composition kit—not a Customer product or a Business product. Public and operational Interfaces share the same Data, Logic, Connection, and Publish model.
page.compositions.booking.name: Booking
page.compositions.booking.headline: Booking as a composition.
page.compositions.booking.lead: Bookings are Data records, Interface forms and calendars, Logic for assignment and conflicts, then Publish to the surfaces people use—not a permanent booking module at the product center.
page.compositions.commerce.name: Commerce + QR
page.compositions.commerce.headline: Catalog, checkout, and QR entry—composed.
page.compositions.commerce.lead: Commerce and QR are Connection + Data + Interface + Publish (and Logic when rules apply). They are not the definition of Zintriq; they are what you can compose today.
page.blog.title: Essays
page.blog.lead: Category education for a primitive system—not feature spam.
page.blog.post.body_p1: Zintriq is a universal primitive system. The question behind every product decision is whether it strengthens Data, Interface, Logic, Connection, or Publish—and whether combinations stay freer.
page.blog.post.body_p2: That is why marketing never centers permanent Website, IoT, AI, or commerce hubs, and why templates are framed as compositions rather than audience silos.
page.blog.post.primitives_not_modules.ex: Why Zintriq refuses permanent website / IoT / AI product centers—and what that means for builders.
page.blog.post.compose_then_publish.exce: Draft isolation, immutable releases, and why public routes never read unpublished work.
